hero.bio: Applied Computer Science student at Hochschule Worms. Full-stack developer building web and mobile applications with modern technologies.

about.subtitle: Who am I
about.title: About me
about.text: I'm a dedicated Computer Science student who works effectively both independently and in teams. I'm passionate about new technologies and always eager to learn something new. From full-stack web applications to mobile apps and data pipelines — I love turning ideas into working software.

1.title: Linux Tutor
1.description: Supporting students with Linux fundamentals: command line, shell scripting, file handling, permissions, sed, and regular expressions. Assisting with homework and exam preparation.

2.title: Inspirer at Hacker School
2.description: Conducting programming workshops for school classes, teaching first steps in Python, HTML/CSS, and MakeCode. Inspiring young people for digital topics and supporting students with no prior experience.

3.title: B.Sc. Applied Computer Science
3.description: Focus areas: Software Engineering, Software Architecture, Process Automation, Networks & IT Security, Cloud Computing.

4.title: Abitur (High School Diploma)
4.description: Graduated with a final grade of 1.5 (German equivalent). General university entrance qualification.

1.title: WormsHub — Smart City Platform
1.description: Modular open-source platform for integrating, normalizing, and serving IoT sensor data in real time. Built as a team project at Hochschule Worms. My biggest challenge: designing a flexible mapping and decoder logic for different sensor data formats.

2.title: REST API Security in the Cloud
2.description: Node.js backend secured with OAuth 2.0 and Azure AD. Azure API Management enforces JWT validation, role-based access control (RBAC), and rate limiting. Clean separation of client, gateway, and resource server.

3.title: E-Commerce Platform
3.description: Web application for personalized product recommendations. Users create a skin profile and receive matching cosmetic products. Features include search, filtering, shopping cart, and authentication.

4.title: Cycle Tracking & Community App
4.description: Cross-platform app for menstrual cycle tracking with symptom documentation, a discussion forum, and a partner mode for selectively sharing health data. Focus on discreet design and privacy.

5.title: Mintopia — Interactive Learning for Kids
5.description: Mobile-first learning website for children with educational videos, quiz modules, and interactive UI elements. Color scheme and usability specifically tailored for young users.

6.title: Used Car Data Pipeline
6.description: End-to-end ETL pipeline that scrapes used-car listings from the Heycar Trader API, cleans and stores them in a PostgreSQL data warehouse, and generates analysis reports.
